# Pipecove

> Pipecove is a web CRM for follow-up. Contacts, pipelines, email, SMS, voice calls, WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, and Instagram direct messages live on one contact record. The marketing site is https://pipecove.com. The product is https://app.pipecove.com.

Pipecove is operated by Pipecove. It runs on a virtual private server the company administers, stores data in PostgreSQL, and sends its own product email from a Mailcow server it operates. Card payments use Stripe. SMS, voice, and WhatsApp numbers use Twilio. Messenger and Instagram use Meta, and only after a workspace connects its own Facebook Page and Instagram professional account.

Phone numbers for SMS, calling, and WhatsApp can be purchased for Australia and the United Kingdom only. More countries are not available yet. Before a number is sold, the workspace submits the identity and address details Twilio requires for that country. Pipecove forwards those details to Twilio. Twilio approves or rejects them.

## Plans (USD, monthly, tax extra)

- Free: $0 forever. 1 seat, 1 workspace, 100 contacts, 25 opportunities, 1 pipeline, 1 automation, email inbox, templates, two-factor sign-in. No card. It does not convert into a paid plan.
- Solo: $19 per month. 1 seat, 2,000 contacts, unlimited opportunities, 3 pipelines, 5 automations, custom fields, calendar, booking, public API, SMS, voice, and AU/UK numbers.
- Growth: $49 per month. 5 seats, 10,000 contacts, unlimited pipelines, 25 automations, plus WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, Instagram DMs, custom objects, and agents and roles.
- Agency: $99 per month. 15 seats, 3 workspaces, unlimited contacts and automations, plus everything in Growth.

SMS, voice, WhatsApp usage, and number rental are prepaid from a usage wallet. They are not included in the monthly price. Messenger and Instagram are included on Growth and Agency.

## Partners

A partner earns 60% of the first subscription payment from a workspace that signs up with their link, then 20% of later subscription payments from that same workspace for 12 months. Wallet top-ups, usage, number rental, tax, and refunds are excluded. Self-referrals are excluded.

Pipecove does not sell personal information. Google API data, if a workspace connects Google Calendar, is used only for that feature and under Google's Limited Use requirements. Meta platform data is used only to show and send the connected inbox.
